name: Bregma
how: Where this CT's frontal and parietal bones meet at the midline, on the outer table (the names from the fitted Z-Anatomy model).

name: External acoustic meatus
how: The ear canal is the shortest way through air from the registered tympanic membrane to outside; the meatus is where it leaves the bone.

name: Kocher's point (Chen 2025)
how: 10 mm in front of the coronal suture along the outer table, 25 mm from the midline.

name: Kocher's point (Park 2020)
how: 10 mm in front of the coronal suture along the outer table, 30 mm from the midline.

name: Medial canthus (projected)
how: Not in this CT (it stops at the forehead): 16.35 mm from the midline (half Chen 2025's mean intercanthal distance), on the line between the external acoustic meatus, as Chen projects it.
